hero.devise: The light that guides every healer
hero.accroche: The tank who survives by a miracle. The heal that lands at the very last second, and the whole group breathing again. Those are the moments we play healers for. Lyorune is a set of healing frames for World of Warcraft: Forever: your whole group in front of your eyes, all your spells under your fingers.
hero.infos: Free · Interface 16001 · English and French · No dependencies
hero.groupe_alt: Five Lyorune healing frames in the middle of a fight

demo.intro: A made-up group, mid-fight. Click a frame to heal that player. If they carry a debuff you can dispel, the click removes it first; if they are down, the same click brings them back.
demo.aide: Keyboard: Tab moves from frame to frame, Enter clicks. Touch: tap the frame.
demo.honnete: In game, every mouse button, alone or with Shift, Ctrl, Alt, casts the spell you picked for it. Here one click does it all, to keep the demo simple.

pins.texte: Renew, Rejuvenation, Riptide: your heals over time sit in the top left corner, visible mid-fight, with Weakened Soul and Forbearance in grey at the end of the row.
Tank, healer or damage dealer. A druid's role comes from their talents, not their current form.
The health your heals and other healers' heals are about to restore, in a lighter shade at the end of the bar.
Power Word: Shield and other absorbs, with what is left to absorb, even in combat.
The frame lights up when you can remove the debuff: blue for magic, purple for curses, brown for diseases, green for poisons. Up to 3 per frame, the most important first, with their seconds left.
Some boss debuffs are hidden from addons: the game draws them itself on the frame, wherever you choose.
A line along the top of the health bar: yellow when the player is building threat, orange when the monster is about to turn on them, red once it is hitting them. There is a threat border too.
Three levels, in dungeons and raids too: in healing range, close (frame faded), far away (about 100 yards or more: faded further, with footprints in the middle).
On your own frame, after a spell that costs mana, a line counts down the 5 seconds before your mana starts coming back.

phares.intro: Four features you won't want to play without, then everything else. Each one has its own checkbox.

items.texte: Every mouse button, alone or with Shift, Ctrl, Alt, casts the spell of your choice on a player's frame, at the rank you want. A trinket can go off with it, and no heal ever goes to an enemy.
Type /lyorune test: a group of 5 to 40 players shows up, wounded and debuffed, so you can try your clicks and tune everything without bothering anyone.
Neon, Clean, Glass, Classic, Heroic, plus a high contrast mode. Four frame shapes, and every element placed, resized or hidden the way you like, for each of your characters.
One profile per group size, battleground and specialization, applied on its own. Send your setup to a friend as a code, or directly in game.
items.saveur: "Copying someone's settings by hand? Never again."

items.texte: A keyboard key, an extra mouse button or the wheel casts a spell on the frame under your mouse.
The debuff type's symbol is added to the colour, and each icon's border takes the colour of its type. The "Always shown" list keeps Weakened Soul and Forbearance in sight.
On a dead player, your heal click casts your resurrection spell.
/lyorune assign: the leader assigns players to each healer, and a gold line marks yours for everyone who has Lyorune. Buffs can be assigned the same way.
Out of combat, the next buff to cast shows in a thin strip under your frames, and one click casts it. On each frame, only your own buffs to cast again, in grey.
Low mana, mana restored, resurrection, in your own words. They go out even while the game hides mana.
In the game's key bindings, keys of your choice open the options, hide the frames, cast the next buff or start test mode.
Write a macro once, then put it on a click or drag it onto one of the game's action bars.
Twelve chapters, a preview cell that shows every setting live, a golden rune on what you changed and a search that finds everything.
Your healer's notebook with today's summary, and the healers' channel in French and in English, if you want to join.

liste.elvui: Lyorune never changes the game's frames or any other addon's: it runs alongside ElvUI, Clique and your other interface addons.

profils.intro: The game's four ready-made profiles, plus high contrast mode, as codes to paste. Copy a code, then in game open the Profiles and sharing chapter, paste it (Ctrl+V) and click Import. Only these settings change, your frames stay where they are, and /lyorune undo takes you back.

voies.intro: Druid, paladin, priest or shaman: Lyorune recognises your class and adapts to your spells.

items.texte: Rejuvenation, Regrowth, Wild Growth: your heals over time show on every frame. Curses and poisons stand out at a glance.
Blessing of Protection and Blessing of Sacrifice tracked, Cleanse for magic, diseases and poisons. Your Light always arrives in time.
Renew, Power Word: Shield, Prayer of Healing: shields and heals visible on the frame. Magic and diseases dispelled with one click.
Riptide, and Earth Shield on the tank shown live with its charges, greyed out the moment it drops. Diseases and poisons spotted in an instant.

pourquoi.intro: What it does well, and what the game will not let it do.
forces: Light. Lyorune reacts to what happens to each player, when it happens. Nothing loops in the background; only range is checked, twice a second.
Built for WoW Forever. In combat the game hides a lot from addons. Lyorune works with what the game is willing to show, or draws itself, rather than guessing.
Click casting included. Nothing else to install to cast your spells with one click.
Hands off everything else. It never changes or hides the game's frames or any other addon's.
Nothing is mandatory. Every feature has its own checkbox: keep only what helps you.
pourquoi.limites_titre: What the game does not allow
limites: The combat log is closed to addons: the healer's notebook counts your successful heals, not the health they restored.
In combat, health and auras are hidden values, so some displays, such as boss debuffs, are drawn by the game itself, in its own way.
Mana is hidden, even out of combat: the low mana announcement works from an estimate (the cost of your spells), not an exact number.
During a boss fight or a PvP match, the game blocks messages between addons: a resurrection in progress is only announced once the fight is over.

installation.intro: Three steps, and a one-minute tutorial welcomes you in game.
etapes: Download the latest version from CurseForge, Wago, WoWInterface or the GitHub Releases page, the only four official sources.
Unzip it into World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\. You should end up with a Lyorune folder. With the CurseForge or Wago app, there is nothing to do: the app takes care of it.
Start the game. No group at hand? Type /lyorune test to try your clicks on a fake group.

items: Lyorune is a free healing frames addon for World of Warcraft: Forever. It shows your whole group or raid and casts your heals with one click on a player's frame.
Which healing addon should I use on WoW Forever?
Lyorune is made for World of Warcraft: Forever (interface 16001). It is light, copes with the values the game hides in combat, and suits priests, druids, paladins and shamans.
Does click casting work on WoW Forever?

Yes, Lyorune has its own. Every mouse button, alone or with Shift, Ctrl or Alt, casts the spell you picked on a player's frame, at the highest rank or the rank you choose. A keyboard key or the mouse wheel can also heal the frame under your cursor.

Yes. Frames follow your group from 5 to 40 players, sorted by group or by role, and a profile per group size kicks in on its own. Test mode shows a fake 40-player raid so you can set everything up out of combat.
Yes. Lyorune is free and can be downloaded from CurseForge (project Lyorune Healing), Wago, WoWInterface or its GitHub Releases page, its only four official sources.
Does Lyorune work with ElvUI or Clique?

Yes. Lyorune never changes the game's frames or any other addon's. It runs alongside ElvUI, Clique and other interface addons. If you prefer Clique or the game's own click casting, one checkbox turns Lyorune's clicks off.

The easiest way: the CurseForge or Wago app, which also installs updates. Otherwise, download the archive, unzip it into World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\ and start the game. A one-minute tutorial opens on first login.
Why is a spell missing from the list?
Type /lyorune spells: Lyorune lists the spells it offers, the ones from your class that are missing and why (not learned, other specialization, passive). An offensive spell is never offered.

I play in the guild La Taverne Nocturne, a relaxed French-speaking PvE guild. Find me on our Discord server to chat, play together or talk about Lyorune.

presse.court: Lyorune is a free healing frames addon for World of Warcraft: Forever. One-click healing, dispels, incoming heals, missing buffs: your whole group in front of your eyes, all your spells under your fingers.
presse.long: Lyorune is a free healing frames addon for World of Warcraft: Forever, written by BellaDroode, a healer in the guild La Taverne Nocturne. Every mouse button casts the spell of your choice on a player's frame; the frame shows health, incoming heals, shields, mana, what to dispel and range, even while the game hides those values in combat. Five themes, four frame shapes, a fake group of 5 to 40 players to tune everything, and profiles you can share as a code. Lyorune is light, in English and French, and never changes the game's frames or any other addon's. It is available on CurseForge, Wago, WoWInterface and GitHub.
